capabilities.name: Body
capabilities.description: A canonical body or object silhouette capable of approved posture changes.

capabilities.name: Head
capabilities.description: An approved head with a real attachment and stable proportions.

capabilities.name: Eyes
capabilities.description: Approved eyes and eyelids with documented shapes.

capabilities.name: Expressive Face
capabilities.description: A facial structure explicitly capable of changing expression.

capabilities.name: Mouth
capabilities.description: An approved mouth, beak or analogous attached feeding/speech structure.

capabilities.name: Legs
capabilities.description: Approved locomotion/support legs with feasible joints.

capabilities.name: Feet
capabilities.description: Approved feet or toes capable of the selected contacts.

capabilities.name: Arms
capabilities.description: Approved upper limbs usable for gestures.

capabilities.name: Hands
capabilities.description: Approved articulated hands with appropriate grasp or finger anatomy.

capabilities.name: Paws
capabilities.description: Approved animal paws with real attachments.

capabilities.name: Ears
capabilities.description: Approved movable ears with stable roots and markings.

capabilities.name: Tail
capabilities.description: An approved tail with a continuous anatomical root.

capabilities.name: Wings
capabilities.description: Approved functional or poseable wings with documented attachment.

capabilities.name: Fins
capabilities.description: Approved attached fins capable of fanning or swimming strokes.

capabilities.name: Antennae
capabilities.description: Approved attached antennae with fixed count and segmentation.

capabilities.name: Fur
capabilities.description: Approved attached fur or hair material that can deform with the body.

capabilities.name: Shell
capabilities.description: An approved shell with anatomically valid retraction.

capabilities.name: Tentacles
capabilities.description: Approved continuously deformable tentacles with fixed count.

capabilities.name: Quadrupedal
capabilities.description: Four-legged body structure supporting a forequarter play bow.

archetypes.name: Generic or unspecified
archetypes.description: Conservative body-only starting point. Declare capabilities from the approved reference before selecting anatomical states.

archetypes.name: Humanoid
archetypes.description: Typical articulated humanoid; remove capabilities absent from the approved reference.

archetypes.name: Quadruped
archetypes.description: Generic four-legged mammal with typical paws, ears and tail; confirm every detail.

archetypes.name: Cat
archetypes.description: Typical cat anatomy with paws, expressive ears and tail; no human hands assumed.

archetypes.name: Dog
archetypes.description: Typical dog anatomy with forepaws, muzzle and tail; no human hands assumed.

archetypes.name: Bird
archetypes.description: Typical winged bird with beak, eyes and feet; no human hands or mammal ears assumed.

archetypes.name: Winged creature
archetypes.description: Conservative winged creature with body, head and feet; add expressive anatomy only when approved.

archetypes.name: Fish
archetypes.description: Aquatic body with eyes, mouth and fins; no arms, feet or human face assumed.

archetypes.name: Insect
archetypes.description: Typical insect with segmented legs, eyes and antennae; wings are not assumed.

archetypes.name: Serpentine creature
archetypes.description: Legless elongated body with approved head, eyes and mouth.

archetypes.name: Blob
archetypes.description: Flexible body-only abstract character; facial features are not assumed.

archetypes.name: Object mascot
archetypes.description: Body-only inanimate mascot; no face, limbs or movement joints assumed.

archetypes.name: Robot
archetypes.description: Conservative articulated robot body and head; do not assume biological mouth or limbs.

archetypes.name: Cephalopod
archetypes.description: Tentacled aquatic body with eyes and mouth, no human hands.

archetypes.name: Shell-bearing creature
archetypes.description: Conservative shell-bearing creature; add limbs only from the approved identity.
